cases.subject: ARITZIA - Requesting alerting for Kafka message failures
cases.Description:
Hi GO Team,
Following last week's Kafka issues between Grey Matter and Robotics Hub, I'd like to formally submit a request to track what was already discussed verbally with @Crystal Welker<mailto:crystal.w@greyorange.com>.

  1.
Alerting for failed messages - We'd like GO to add alerts that notify Aritzia when a message fails to reach Robotics Hub after all resend attempts.
  2.
Resend timing options - We'd also like to understand what options are available for the timing of message resends. Is it possible to configure resends at different intervals? For example:

  *   1st resend: within 15 seconds
  *   2nd and 3rd resends: 1–2 minutes after the 1st attempt

Could you please confirm next steps and an estimated timeline for these requests?
Thank you,
Matthew Teasdale
Director, Solution Delivery, Distribution Technology
ARITZIA
415 Boyne St
New Westminster, BC  V3M 5K2

cases.Subject: Continuity Fail Errors on Green Chargers
cases.subject: Continuity Fail Errors on Green Chargers
cases.Description:
We are still getting continuity fails on green chargers with new control boards. Multiple new control boards were tested, all having the same issue. Additional information and steps taken can be seen via Case Number 00270793, as this is a recurring issue. 

The resolution of Case Number 00270793 was correct for one charger, but the other 5 (and any more that require a control board replacement) will produce the same error of "Continuity Failed" at the end of the charge. Any assistance would be appreciated.

INFO:
-Using older control boards (or old ones from another working charger) does NOT produce the error. The issue is only occurring in the newest control board shipments that we've received. 
-The grounding/bonding of components has been tested on multiple chargers but the issue is still occurring.

cases.Subject: Ryder ML| Pick Station LPN Association Error-URGENT
cases.subject: Ryder ML| Pick Station LPN Association Error-URGENT
cases.Description:
Hello GreyOrange Team,
We are raising this as a P2 issue due to an LPN association error occurring at the GO pick station.
Error displayed at pick station:
“LPN scanned is not associated with this order.”
Affected order details:

  *   GO Order / External Service Request ID: 8557762
  *   Pick Line: 8557765
  *   SKU: CZ992A#B1H
  *   LPN / Container ID being scanned: 00000886980034999995

We validated the SCALE → GO messaging for this order.
The outbound GO_OUT_PickRequest from SCALE sends container ID 00000886980034999995 under order_options.container_id. The same value is also sent as the
The GO sync response shows:

  *   Order status: CREATED
  *   Pick-line status: CREATED
  *   container_id: 00000886980034999995
  *   label_mapping_id: 00000886980034999995
  *   No exceptions reported in the response
  *
GO virtual container ID: 8884691

Despite the container/LPN being present in both the request and GO sync response, when 00000886980034999995 is scanned at the pick station, GO reports that the LPN is not associated with the order.
Please issue a bridge call to  investigate the LPN-to-order association for order 8557762 and determine why GO is rejecting LPN 00000886980034999995 during picking.
Please also validate the relationship between:

  *   SCALE LPN/Container: 00000886980034999995
  *   GO Order: 8557762
  *   GO Pick Line: 8557765
  *   GO Virtual Container: 8884691

Priority: P2
Thanks,
Raunaq

Problem Summary:  At outbound workstation WKS 02-002, there are four robots that are not moving, 145,143, 106, 66, 41. They have been in this state for over an hour without any reported faults

**Site Name:** SP04 Mercado Livre

**Level of Urgency (High/Medium/Low):** High

**Estimated Number of Users Affected:** 10

**Affected Application (GO, WMx, BAx, SMART, KRONOS):** GO

**Area Affected:** Bots / Robotics

**Operational Impact:** Loss of real-time monitoring and visibility of robotic operations.

**Problem Summary:** On October 30th, between 05:31 AM and 05:40 AM (BRT, UTC-3), we experienced a GreyOrange Health Check connectivity alert in Datadog, along with an outage of the Tower platform at SP04.

**Details:** During this period, the Health Check metric dropped to zero, triggering a connectivity alert in Datadog. At the same time, the GreyOrange Tower platform became unavailable, affecting our ability to monitor robotic operations.

The incident lasted approximately 9 minutes, and the Health Check returned to normal at 05:40 AM.

We request your support in analyzing the communication and system logs to identify the root cause of this incident and determine whether the Health Check failure and Tower unavailability were related.

cases.Subject: Parallel Pick Tote Splitting Enhancement
cases.subject: Parallel Pick Tote Splitting Enhancement
cases.Description:
Where We Are Now 
The current system limitation restricts a parallel pick from being systematically split into multiple totes with each tote having a unique SI label, creating the issue where items are unable to fit into the initial carton. 
 
Current State Example
Picker grabs 6 items from MSU and places into the holding area.
The AIO directs the picker to place the 6 items in the MSIO tote 1.

Issue:
The MSIO tote 1 is nearly full and can only physically accommodate 4 of the 6 items. 
The picker will have to physically place the remaining 2 items into new MSIO tote (tote 2) while still being systematically tied to the carton ID from the previous (MSIO tote 1). 
Result: All 6 items are tied to the carton ID from MSIO tote 1 despite physically being picked into 2 separate MSIO cartons.

Risks of Inaction 
There are many potential issues that may arise from not being able to both physically and systematically split during a parallel pick such as the following: 
Product Integrity 
o   Pickers have overstuffed units into the carton in the past– potentially damaging the garment and resulting in overfilled totes where units have fallen out on to the conveyor  
Systematic Record Discrepancy 
o   Pickers flagged in the past for pick errors due to physical and systematic miss-alignment, stemming from pickers releasing singles tote during a parallel pick 
SLA Risk 
o   SLA risk when singles orders are split physically but not systematically, especially when inventory for the missing SKU is low  
 
Where We Want to Be (Future State) 
Create a reliable picking process that allows oversized singles cartons to be both physically and systematically split during parallel picking. This will ensure product integrity, maintain inventory accuracy, improve picker experience, and eliminate the need for Pack Hospital to reconcile orders. 
 
Future State Process 
1. System allows a parallel pick to be systematically split into multiple totes when picks exceed physical tote capacity.
2. Pi...

cases.Subject: Concerns Regarding System Performance and Potential Impact from Global GreyOrange Infrastructure Load
cases.subject: Concerns Regarding System Performance and Potential Impact from Global GreyOrange Infrastructure Load
cases.Description:
Dear GreyOrange Support Team,

We have repeatedly experienced periods of reduced system performance and slow data communication within our GreyOrange installation.

These issues are most noticeable during Black Friday and other peak operational periods, but they also occur at various times throughout the year.

As GreyOrange operates a global platform supporting many customers worldwide, we would like to better understand whether fluctuations in performance could be related to shared infrastructure resources and prioritization of capacity across the customer base.

Specifically, we would like to understand whether customers with significantly larger installations or higher transaction volumes could influence the availability of centralized resources, potentially resulting in reduced performance for smaller installations such as ours during periods of exceptionally high demand.

Some of the challenges we have observed include:


  *   Increased response times across the system.
  *   Delays in communication between system components.
  *   Timeouts and task execution failures.
  *   General degradation of system performance during peak operational periods.

Given the substantial increase in activity that occurs globally during events such as Black Friday, we would appreciate clarification on whether any centralized services, cloud infrastructure, databases, message brokers, API gateways, monitoring systems, or other shared GreyOrange resources could become constrained and consequently affect customer site performance.

In particular, we would appreciate your input on the following:


  1.  Which components of the GreyOrange platform rely on centralized or cloud-based services.
  2.  Whether overall global platform utilization can impact the performance experienced at individual customer sites.
  3.  How GreyOrange manages capacity allocation and prioritization during periods of exceptionally high system load.
  4.  Whether larger customers with higher transaction vol...

cases.Subject: Bot-50 is loading a tote in tray where already another tote
cases.subject: Bot-50 is loading a tote in tray where already another tote
cases.Description:
Hi GreyOrange
Please assign this ticket to TAC to analyze this case: Bot 50 has 2 totes
in its tray and 1 tote in its fork. The bot is trying to place a tote on
Tray 7, but a tote is physically present on Tray 7 that is not showing in
the system.
*Below are the tote IDs: *
Tray 7 - 22292
Tray 6 - 14147
Fork - 4303
*Analysis from Harware team as per them issue with GMC*
* ncomplete load list. GMC’s updateLoadStatus listed 5 of 7 totes.
* No verification. The VDA applied the list without scanning, so trays 6
and 7 stayed unknown.
* Unloads emptied the list. After the five unloads the VDA showed No load,
so GMC treated the bot as empty.
* Collision. GMC assigned TRAY_7; the VDA sent the move with no occupancy
check, and the bot stopped on the occupied tray.
* Early FINISHED. The VDA reported toteLoad done on the ack, so GMC fired
the next order while the bot was mid-move.
-- 
Thanks and Regards,

Ramesh chander
GreyOrange India (P) Ltd.

Contact:+14709672793

cases.Subject: Validation on messages from serial scan exceptions
cases.subject: Validation on messages from serial scan exceptions
cases.Description:
Hello Team, 

we need investigation on these scenarios and what messages are being sent from GM to scale when these occur:

 Suggested scenarios contributing to SCALE failed messages:	
1	Serial/label-tracked 10 cases WHERE CASE QTY IS 1:  rack is short Qty not found in other rack 9 labels scanned,  9 serials completed; 
1	Serial/label-tracked 10 cases WHERE CASE QTY IS 1:  rack is short Qty is found in other rack 9 labels scanned,  9 serials completed from first rack and last is completed from the last rack; 
1	Serial/label-tracked 10 cases WHERE CASE QTY IS 1: 10 labels scanned, but only 9 serials completed; user cancels the last case.
1	Serial/label-tracked 10 cases  WHERE CASE QTY IS 1: Only 9 labels and 9 serials scanned; user cancels the last case.
1	SKU serial tracking  WHERE CASE QTY IS >1: Two cases × 6 units; first case completes 6/6, second completes 5/6. scans after confimg KQ of 6/6
1	SKU non serial tracking  WHERE CASE QTY IS >1 : Two cases × 6 units; first case completes 6/6, second completes 5/6.

cases.Subject: Adjust all MSU Dimensions to be 2cm bigger
cases.subject: Adjust all MSU Dimensions to be 2cm bigger
cases.Description: We often have to induct boxes that are slightly too big to fit into a given space on an MSU, and it causes the put-calc algorithm to say there are no suitable spaces in the field for the box. If every space in MD would be about 2cm longer and wider, then we could squeeze boxes into the MSU's, and operationally nothing would be affected.

cases.Subject: Add count type field to audits table
cases.subject: Add count type field to audits table
cases.Description:
Hello GO team,
We need your support from the D&A Supply Chain Aritzia team to diagnose and implement a solution for adding a count type field to the audits table.
Issue

  *   Need a new field to capture count type. Currently dependent on naming logic which is non-standard and identifies only about 50% of count types

Impact

  *   Unable to classify all audits based on count types for analysis and reporting

Scope

  *   Table: audits

Request

  *
Introduce a new field count_type to capture the audit count type
  *   Align data ingestion/mapping to populate count_type for all audits
  *   Clarification on data model changes, migration steps, and validation approach
  *
A proposed plan with timeline

Thanks in advance!

Best regards,

Andres Fabian Pineda Martinez
Analytics Engineer Contractor, Supply Chain & Analytics Engineering
Bogotá, Colombia (GMT -5)
apineda@aritzia.com | Mobile +57 3160566950
[https://yorkdale.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/10/Aritzia-Logo-REGULAR-Final.png]

cases.subject: [HIGH PRIORITY] Request for GO support: distinguishing audit counts and grouping
cases.Description:
Hello GO team,
We need your support from the D&A Supply Chain Aritzia team to diagnose and implement a solution for distinguishing 1st, 2nd, and 3rd counts and groups of audits and reaudits in the audits table.
Issue

  *
Need to distinguish the order of counts (1st, 2nd, 3rd...) and groups of audits and reaudits
  *
Currently can only differentiate between counts and groups because of the naming logic we implemented; it doesn’t work for system audits (generic name)

Impact

  *   It isn’t possible to identify which reaudits are tied to a system audit that triggers the reaudits. This will impact count accuracy and inventory accuracy metrics to measure associate performance.

Scope

  *   Table: audits

Request

  *   New fields to identify audit groups and sequence (e.g., group_id, sequence_number, parent_audit_id) to establish relationships between audits and reaudits, including system audits
  *
Clarification on data model changes and validation approach
  *
A proposed remediation plan with timeline; we can provide a data sample

cases.Subject: GTP - PPTL light data for Put stations
cases.subject: GTP - PPTL light data for Put stations
cases.Description:
Hello GO Team,
We understand that the current setup for the PPTL lights at the Put Station displays the item count for a tote only when an associate scans that tote for put-away.
However, each roll cage contains 8 totes, and the remaining totes show a count of zero until they are individually scanned.
Our request is to determine whether it is possible for the PPTL system to display the item counts for all totes on the roll cage as soon as the roll cage is inducted into the Put PPS Station, rather than requiring each tote to be scanned individually.
Could you please let us know if this functionality is possible?

cases.Subject: Sorter Machine Sensor Issue <> Grey Orange
cases.subject: Sorter Machine Sensor Issue <> Grey Orange
cases.Description:
Hi GreyOrange Team,
This is to bring to your attention the ongoing issue with the sorter machine. As confirmed by Srinath, is related to a sensor malfunction.
We have been experiencing this issue for the past two days, and it is significantly impacting our shipment processing operations. Due to the sorter malfunction, we are facing difficulties in processing and dispatching shipments on time to meet the scheduled connections.
Additionally, we have observed that the sorter machine is incorrectly accepting Hold shipments, K-File shipments, and high-value shipments, which should not be routed through the sorter. This is a serious operational concern, as it may lead to shipment misrouting, processing delays and service-level breaches.
Considering the impact on daily operations and timely shipment movement, requesting the team to investigate the sensor issue on priority and resolve it as soon as possible. Pls also ensure that the sorter is functioning correctly and that restricted shipment categories are not being processed through the machine.
Pls treat this matter as urgent and your immediate support and intervention are highly appreciated.


Regards,
Deepak Gowda S

cases.Subject: RIL Robot Issues
cases.subject: RIL Robot Issues
cases.Description:
Grey Orange,

Today, someone called me to the production floor.  Shown below is the
picture below shows what was happening with the robots:

[image: image.png]

[image: image.png]

RIL8234:  Robot Blocked.  I took control of this robot and moved it out of
the way.

RIL8236:  I thought it was trying to pull into its parking spot but that
was not the case.  It was tasked to go to the other end.  After moving
8236, I brought 8234 back onto the highway and it continued with its task.

RIL8235: Robot has an error.  Please fix it.  I moved this robot one spot
and it continued reporting the same error.  Afterwards, I moved it back to
its home position and the error persisted.  I shut down and reset the
robot.  This seemed to solve the problem.

All of this occurred around 1:34 PM EST.


A little later RIL8233 was stuck outside the field trying to pick up an
empty MSU at station 13.  I thought the reflector issue was happening again
but after replacing the reflectors, the robot still would not go underneath
the MSU.  I checked the QR code underneath the MSU and it was fine.  The
robot would not allow me to take control, so I shut it off and restarted
it.  This seemed to solve the issue.

I'm not sure why I had to shut down the robots to get them back on task.
They were all shut down over the weekend (meaning Saturday through
Monday).

Thanks,

*Stephanie Ayres*

cases.subject: SRE-26564 Re: Urgent request: Confirmation of security patching and exposure status
cases.Description:
Nitesh Saini commented:

Hi Ganesh,

We conducted an initial assessment to verify PHP usage across our applications and infrastructure.


*


*Application Review:* Confirmed that PHP is not used in our GreyMatter and gstore applications.
*Source Code Verification:* Reviewed the relevant GitHub repositories and found no traces of PHP files.

cases.Description:
Dear GOR Team,

I would like to escalate the recurring issues with the GOR sorter and the lack of response from the GOR team during the night shift.

Over the past month, we have been experiencing frequent sorter breakdowns due to repeated pipe damage. Today, the system stopped multiple times, further affecting smooth operations.

The following issues require immediate attention:

- Repeated pipe damage: The issue has been occurring frequently over the past month, causing repeated system stoppages.
- Pressure gun unavailable: The required pressure gun is not available at the site.
- Scanner cable issue: The scanner cable frequently becomes loose, affecting system operations.
- Lack of night-shift support: The GOR team is not responding to calls when support is required, leaving site issues unresolved and causing delays in troubleshooting.

@Ajay Kharche (DHL eCom Blue Dart IN)<mailto:AKharche@bluedart.com> & @Moulin Shah (DHL eCom Blue Dart IN)<mailto:moulin.shah@bluedart.com> sir,

As the peak season is approaching, these recurring issues and the lack of timely technical support could significantly impact operations and our team's planning.

I kindly request you to investigate these concerns, arrange permanent corrective actions for the sorter issues, and ensure that the GOR team responds promptly to calls, especially during the night shift.

Your immediate attention and support are required to prevent further breakdowns and ensure smooth operations during the upcoming peak season.

Kindly look into this matter and help us resolve it immediately so that shipment WDL can be processed smoothly.

cases.Subject: Butler 8645 - Safety Incident During PAUSE / Emergency Stop Release
cases.subject: Butler 8645 - Safety Incident During PAUSE / Emergency Stop Release
cases.Description:
Hi,

Reopen case: 00262375

This issue has been reported previously following several similar incidents, including incidents involving other Butlers.

The previous ticket was closed with the understanding that you would investigate the issue further and return to us with an explanation and a solution.

However, from the time of our previous report until this new incident, we have not received any further information, explanation, or corrective solution.

Unfortunately, the same dangerous behaviors have now occurred again on Butler 8645.

During the PAUSE period, our operator carried out several recovery attempts on Butler 8645 by releasing the emergency stop.

According to the operator's observation, Butler 8645 moved forward unexpectedly with high acceleration when the emergency stop was released, despite the installation still being in PAUSE.

The operator therefore had to reactivate the emergency stop to stop the Butler.

Our subsequent investigation of the Butler logs confirms that physical movement occurred during the emergency stop/release sequence.

The logs contain significant changes in wheel encoder values and calculated position between several of the emergency stop events.

Because this is a recurring safety-related issue, this ticket must NOT be closed until the cause has been properly investigated and you have provided:


  1.  A technical explanation of why these behaviors can occur.
  2.  Identification of the root cause.
  3.  A corrective solution preventing the Butler from moving unexpectedly after emergency stop release.
  4.  Confirmation of whether other Butlers may be affected by the same issue.
  5.  Confirmation of any required corrective actions, software changes, configuration changes, or safety measures.

Simply closing the ticket again without identifying and correcting the cause would leave the underlying problem unresolved.

This is particularly important because the reported behaviors involve unexpected high acceleration immediately f...

cases.subject: Aritzia DC01P | GO STG | Cubby light does not light up when picking singles
cases.Description:
Hi GO team,

We are currently experiencing an issue when picking singles along with multis in GO Staging environment.

  1.
When picking singles, message comes up on Pick Back screen "Scan a Tote" but none of the cubby's light up at all.
  2.
Cubby with bin tag "single" should light up so user knows which cubby to associate the carton with.
  3.
After we scan the carton ID, still none of the cubbies light up, which means user gets stuck on this screen.
  4.
Only way to get out of this situation is to wait for MSU at the Pick Front, and then it prompts a different cubby and lights up as well.
  5.
Also, user cannot reuse the carton ID which was scanned for tote, even when it was not associated with any of the cubbies.

Please watch attached video as we have recorded the behavior. We are able to replicate it everytime.

FYI: We recently made a change with the Profile "ECOM_114_TO_217" and it is the same profile we used for picking. I don't think profile could cause this issue but just in case.



Let me know if you need anything else.

Thank you,



Jatin Kumar
Senior Solution Systems Analyst
ARITZIA

7233 Progress Way
Delta, BC V4G 1E7

cases.subject: GOR DOUBLE DECKER DELHI SORTER ISSUES NEED TO RECTIFY BEFORE 15/10/2026
cases.Description:
Hi @Anil Kumar (Linear Sorter) <anil.kumar1@greyorange.com>,

I inspected the sorter on both feedlanes and identified the following
issues that require immediate attention:

Upper Deck:

1.  Weighing conveyor belt is misaligned, with worn sprocket and bearing.
2.  Dashboard is displaying belt images only; parcel images are missing.
3.  Inclination conveyor modular sprockets and belt require replacement.
4.  Acrylic rubber strips on the arms are worn out and need replacement.
5.  Shock absorber needs replacement.

Lower Deck:

1.  Scanning conveyor belt links are damaged and need replacement.
2.  Weighing conveyor belt is misaligned.
3.  Curve conveyor links are damaged and require overhauling.
4.  Main modular conveyor links need replacement.
5.  Acrylic rubber strips on the arms need replacement (flap gaps are
causing sortfails).
6.  Dashboard is displaying incomplete (half) images.

Reference images are attached. Please arrange for these issues to be
rectified before the October 15, 2026 deadline.

Regards,
Rajat Yadav
Manager (P&IE)

Please check the mapping of access level for this tool and let us know if this is possible.

Thank you,
Swadhin Gurjar

cases.subject: Aritzia Defect 232:  ARITZIA NON-PROD | GM 7.9 | ARITZIA NON-PROD | GM 7.9 | Duplicate taskComplete Messages Received for Completed Pick Tasks
cases.Description:
*   Title: Aritzia Defect 232:  ARITZIA NON-PROD | GM 7.9 | ARITZIA NON-PROD | GM 7.9 | Duplicate taskComplete Messages Received for Completed Pick Tasks
  *   Severity: M
  *   Symptom:

During Blue Sky picking for both Single Order and Multi Order eCommerce order types, picks completed successfully in GO and were successfully posted back to BY. However, Robotics Hub botEvent received duplicate taskComplete messages for the same task, despite only one completion event being expected.

The duplicate taskComplete messages were received with WMS Acknowledgement = "Success", indicating both messages were accepted and processed.

  *   Steps to Reproduce:

1.       Execute a Blue Sky pick for a Single Order or Multi Order eCommerce task.

2.       Complete the pick in GO.

3.       Review the Robotics Hub botEvent and TaskView logs.

  *   Expected:

For each completed pick task, Robotics Hub should receive only one taskComplete message corresponding to the successful completion of the task.

  *   Actual:

Robotics Hub receives two taskComplete messages for the same task, both with WMS Acknowledgement = "Success".

  3.
Create a new storage strategy named "Slow Mover Side Strategy" that prioritizes side locations.

Please refer to the attached email thread for additional context and business requirements.

Before any changes are implemented, please provide the following for Aritzia's review and approval:

Detailed change description

Configuration values and settings to be updated

Implementation steps
  *
Estimated effort and timeline

Potential impacts and risks

Validation and testing approach

Rollback/fallback plan

Please do not proceed with any changes until written approval has been received from the Aritzia team.

cases.Subject: ARITZIA NP6 – Pick Tasks Marked Unfulfillable During Active Audit
cases.subject: ARITZIA NP6 – Pick Tasks Marked Unfulfillable During Active Audit
cases.Description:
Subject: ARITZIA NON-PRD | NP6 - Pick Tasks marked Unfulfillable when there is Audit



Severity: 2

​

Description:

Symptom:
Order status changes from Created -> Unfulfillable when there is a pending audit for the required SKU with Qty 1.

Environment: NP6/GO STG

Scenario 1: FAILED
SKU: 76560003
Available inventory in BY and GO: 1
* Created Audit Task in GO: 1334
* 1st Pick Task ID: 8815780
* 2nd Pick Task ID: 8815786
Both Pick Tasks were marked Unfulfillable in GO and picks were cancelled in BY.


Scenario 2: SUCCESS
I also tested a scenario when available qty is more than 1 in both GO and BY.
SKU: 81528011
Available Qty in BY and GO: 3
* Created Audit Task in GO: 1335​
* Created Pick Task: 8815794
* Completed Pick successfully
* Completed Audit successfully


Steps to Reproduce:
* Create an Audit in GO for the sku which has qty = 1
* Create a Pick task for the same sku
* Open the PPS station which has the right profile
* Check the status of the Pick Task


Expected:
Sohail to confirm the expected behavior.
Is GO system supposed to cancel the pick and mark it as unfulfillable?



Actual:
Pick task status changes to Unfulfillable and Pick is cancelled in BY.





link

closed.Subject: Portal 3 doesn't give out weight limit alert when creating LPN expectation
closed.subject: Portal 3 doesn't give out weight limit alert when creating LPN expectation
closed.Description:
Ongoing issue, no timestamps available.

Our inbound team reported that shortly after the latest build upgrade they have experienced an issue with pre put tool where the system allows the creation of the LPN expectation without giving the weight limit breached alert and only gives the alert when they attempt to finalize and release the pallets.

This is not a desired functionality, as the weights might reflect different in the packaging vs. inventory parameters. The team needs to know if the system considers the attempted put task over weight limit before they physically move the goods on to the rack.

You can find an image attached describing the error message, please let us know if you need further on-site validation.

Best regards,

Antti

closed.Subject: Dillard's - Cartons refused with "TOTE IN_USE" alert, request auto-release of carton reservations
closed.subject: Dillard's - Cartons refused with "TOTE IN_USE" alert, request auto-release of carton reservations
closed.Description:
Hi Team,

At Dillard's, some cartons sent from WMS to GO are never put away or
cancelled, so GO keeps the carton ID reserved. When the label is used
again, GO refuses it with the "TOTE IN_USE" alert. The carton then cannot
be put away until GO support clears it.

*Impact:*

   - 9 cases in October so far (7 TOTE IN_USE, 2 stale put tasks), and 31
   in the 90 days to 07-Oct
   - About 1 in 6 cartons sent to GO is never put away or cancelled (5,796
   of 35,752, 08-Aug to 07-Oct)

*Dillard's Request: *Automatically release any carton reservation not put
away within 30 days, so a reused label is accepted

Please help prioritize this and share an ETA as we are receiving manual
tickets mentioned below for clearing.

Related cases: Oct 00289325, 00289612, 00289947, 00290005, 00290092,
00293342, 00294579, 00296718, 00299854 · Sep 00282772, 00284503, 00288011,
00289056.

Regards,
Jaspreet Singh
Customer Experience Manager | +91 9899260025
GreyOrange Inc. | www.greyorange.com

closed.Subject: Owens and Minor || Stale tote task after changing PPS mode from audit
closed.subject: Owens and Minor || Stale tote task after changing PPS mode from audit
closed.Description:
We found one case where tote task was present for tote which was on storable location.
```(butler_server@localhost)22> tote_task:get_by_id(<<"ba791cf2-2e8c-409c-9e77-bcbc7d84d427">>).
{ok,#tote_task{task_key = <<"ba791cf2-2e8c-409c-9e77-bcbc7d84d427">>,
               subtask_type = relay_task,tote_id = <<"9100013041">>,
               destination = 6,
               subtask_key = <<"90c7bbf9-3187-43a3-9994-60a333f33751">>,
               timestamp = {{2026,10,27},{15,28,54}},
               destination_type = pps,status = created}}```

Upon checking further there were not relay_pps_task or relay_tote_task present for this tote
```(butler_server@localhost)16> relay_pps_task:get_by_id(<<"90c7bbf9-3187-43a3-9994-60a333f33751">>).
{error,notfound}
(butler_server@localhost)17> relay_tote_task:get_by_id(<<"90c7bbf9-3187-43a3-9994-60a333f33751">>).
{error,notfound}```

Upon checking further we found that there was an audit task created for this tote but the pps mode was changed from audit due to which the audit RTR was cancelled as you can see below
mhs/info.log.5
Request bc20f475 created with task key ba791cf2 (15:28:54). check_same_tote_task_for_relay retaining tote_task in created state (15:31:26). Store-back loop on TLOC_0062452.
mhs/warning.log.2
Cancellation received by transport_request_event_handler (15:33:44.684).
pf/info.log.2
Pausing audits for PPS 6 for mode change audit to pick (15:33:43.021). send_rack_request_cancellation_event for iELsbbMYuh (15:33:44.677). New request b0c705ed for PPS 4 (15:45:20).
pf/warning.log.*
PPS 6 set inactive at 15:44:52 and several later times.

Need to understand why this tote task was not cleared up

closed.Description:
Hi,

We would like to request the permanent removal of barcode 001.011 from the Butler mapping

Barcode 001.011 must not be used as a travel path or parking position for any Butler, as Butler movement over or onto this location causes recurring issues

At present, we have had to create and position a fictitious Butler on barcode 001.011 in the system to prevent other Butlers from travelling over or parking on this location

This is only a workaround and means that we cannot use this Butler in normal operation

We do not require further support or troubleshooting for this issue

We have investigated and worked with this problem through support for several years, and the permanent solution we require is simply to remove/disable barcode 001.011 from the mapping, ensuring that it is excluded from all Butler routing

Once barcode 001.011 has been permanently removed from the mapping, we can remove the fictitious occupancy and return the Butler currently used for this purpose to normal operation

Please arrange for 001.011 to be permanently removed or blocked in the mapping/routing system

Thank you in advance.

closed.Subject: Request for GO Roles, Profiles, and Permissions Documentation
closed.subject: Request for GO Roles, Profiles, and Permissions Documentation
closed.Description:
Hi @GO Service<mailto:service@greyorange.com> team,

As part of our ongoing GO Roles and Permissions review, we are looking to better understand the current security model and access controls within GO.

Could you please provide detailed documentation for the roles, profiles, and permissions currently available in GO, including:

  *   A list of all available roles that can be assigned to users.
  *   The purpose of each role and the intended user group.
  *   The specific permissions and capabilities associated with each role.
  *   Any relationship between Roles, Profiles, and Permissions, including how access is inherited or combined.
  *   The menus, dashboards, screens, modules, and functions that each role can access.
  *   Any system-defined or out-of-the-box roles (e.g., Warehouse Manager, Team Lead, Supervisor, etc.) and their corresponding access rights.
  *   Any roles that are obsolete, deprecated, or no longer recommended for use.

We have identified several roles that are available for user assignment, but the permissions and capabilities associated with those roles are not clearly documented or visible within the application. This information will help ensure our role definitions align with GO's intended security model and support our user access review.
Additionally, if there is existing documentation describing the GO security architecture and best practices for role assignment, we would appreciate receiving that as well.

Thank you,

closed.Subject: Aritzia 1905- Enhancement - GO - Send Only One TakenOff Message Per Singles Tote
closed.subject: Aritzia 1905- Enhancement - GO - Send Only One TakenOff Message Per Singles Tote
closed.Description:
Opening on behalf of kprakash@aritzia.com and the ATZ team

Currently we are receiving a "takenoff" message for every single eComm
singles task picked into the same physical tote. 20 different orders picked
into a singles tote means 20 taken offs. Since there is only one tote
needing one move, 19 extra taken offs create unnecessary noise.

BY WMS only needs one. We are currently handling this through BY WMS by
ignoring / filtering taken off messages in a deferred queue.  This
enhancement request is to have GO not send extras in the first place.

Was a legacy request from E2E testing phase.

closed.Subject: HMSS - SEV 2 - Inventory Attributes and Owner Tags Missing for 95 SKUs
closed.subject: HMSS - SEV 2 - Inventory Attributes and Owner Tags Missing for 95 SKUs
closed.Description:
Hi Team,

We are currently experiencing a large-scale recurrence of the known issue where inventory records in MD > Inventory > GTP Listing are missing the expected Attributes and Owner Tags. As a result, impacted inventory is only showing the system storage tag, leading to sort pick exceptions and inventory integrity concerns.

This issue was previously reported under GO Case #00298331 and is related to the known defect previously investigated under GO Case #00295094, where positive adjustments/audit activities caused inventory attributes and owner tags to be removed from inventory records.

The issue has now expanded significantly and is currently impacting 95 unique SKUs across multiple locations.

Observed Behavior:

Attributes section is blank in GTP Listing.
Owner tag is missing from inventory records.
Inventory only displays the system storage tag.
Inventory becomes eligible for incorrect sort-pick behavior.
Operations team continues to identify additional affected SKUs.

Reference Tickets:

GO Case #00298331

Request:

Please investigate whether the affected SKUs are experiencing the same known issue.
Confirm if the previous hotfix has failed or if a new defect is causing inventory attributes to be removed.
Perform the required script/workaround to restore attributes and owner tags for the impacted inventory.
Provide RCA and permanent fix timeline as the issue continues to reoccur despite previous remediation.
Escalate to Product/Engineering team for urgent review.

closed.Subject: RyderML Issue  : Barcode Item Master Update Failing When Inventory Exists
closed.subject: RyderML Issue  : Barcode Item Master Update Failing When Inventory Exists
closed.Description:
Hi GreyOrange Support Team,
We’ve identified an instance of Item Master message  failure from SCALE to GM with:
ERR002 – Qty, hierarchy or barcode updation of Item is not allowed as it exists in inventory
Sample data: Item 3E5F8AA, new barcode 555888495. (in STG Env, and W3T08A in PRD)
We understand restricting case quantity (hierarchy changes) when inventory exists. However, adding a new barcode should not be blocked with this error/ reason, since vendors do introduce new barcodes for their SKUs while inventory for the existing item is still on hand in the warehouse or in stores.
Operationally, users cannot just remove and re-induct all existing inventory each time a new supplier barcode is introduced. The new barcode should be able to flow through ERP → SCALE → GM as an Item Master attribute without impacting the existing inventory levels.
Please review why barcode additions are subject to this restriction and advise on next steps to allow new barcodes updates .
Thanks,
Hassan

closed.Subject: Luxottica Atlanta | Issue in resolving tpids for order 344(external service request)
closed.subject: Luxottica Atlanta | Issue in resolving tpids for order 344(external service request)
closed.Description:
Hi,

Order 344 went into exception even though payload was correct. Upon further
troubleshooting, we found an issue in IRS resolving multiple TPIDs, which
caused the order to go into exception. Consequently, the site team
cancelled the order, aligning with the process agreed upon with the
customer.

On further analysis with Priya, she confirmed its an issue which needs to
be raised with Put team. Can you create an EA for Put team with sev 2
priority, including following analysis:

Order 91914 was marked unfulfillable because it lost a race for the
last units of reservation e2ad4c16 (tpid 2249). The line had plenty of
stock left: reservation 7479b4be (tpid 386) still had 135 or more
units remaining.

The stock was not short. Confirm picked the wrong row and never retried.

1. The line had two rows, tpid 386 with 145 remaining and tpid 2249
with 95 remaining. That is 240 in total, against an order qty of 5.
2. Nineteen orders (91880 to 91966) confirmed 5 each against e2ad
between 23:28:17 and 23:28:29. By my count of the rows you pasted,
that adds up to exactly 95. The last of them, order 91892, took e2ad
to remaining = 0 at 23:28:29.
3. Order 91914 arrived at 23:28:29.44. It is the 20th order after
those 19, and it hit e2ad in the same second.
4. do_confirm resolves candidates with a dirty read, outside any
transaction. It ranks by the order's possible_tpids. greedy_consume
then took all 5 units from e2ad, which the stale read still showed as
having stock. That is why the log says assignments_count=1.
5. commit_confirm re-reads the row under lock and finds
CurrentRemaining (0) < 5. It aborts with insufficient_quantity
(inv_res_manager.erl:3696). The code comment there says: "concurrent
transaction may have consumed qty between resolution and commit."
6. Nothing re-resolves after that abort. The 5 units are never tried
against 7479b4be. Pick's resolve_reservations turns the error into
db_functions:abort({irs_request_failed, ...}), and the root order is
marked unfulfil...

closed.Subject: CG Breached racks causing issues
closed.subject: CG Breached racks causing issues
closed.Description:
Hello,

After having version upgrade from 6.9 to 7.4.0.22 we have had issues with CG Breached racks. Initially there was 110 racks with this breach because some configuration value was set to 1000000 after the update. After the update we agreed to change that configuration value to 10000.

PROBLEM NOW is that these CG breached racks keep increasing (currently 114). And when we have to pick from those, systems asks to pick articles individually. So there might be a pick task for 10 pieces but we need to pick them one by one. This is REALLY slow. With version 6.9 we did not have this issue.

closed.Subject: Critical B2B Order Flow Issue in RTP – Immediate Attention Required
closed.subject: Critical B2B Order Flow Issue in RTP – Immediate Attention Required
closed.Description:
Hello Team,

I want to bring immediate attention to a critical issue affecting RTP for B2B. We have been struggling to get orders released and flowing through RTP for picking, and this issue was already occurring during the day shift. Orders are being created in the system, but nothing is coming through for our team to pick.

This is becoming a serious operational concern. We cannot keep employees productive when there are orders in the system, but no work is being released to RTP. Despite having three drivers dedicated to replenishment, we are still struggling to keep the operation moving because the orders are simply not coming through as expected.

Around 4:30 PM, we started seeing some cages arrive at STN 15–14. However, once those cages were picked, the flow stopped completely, and we have not received anything since then.

I have been in direct communication with the Automation Team, and they confirmed that a ticket has already been created and they are actively working on the issue. I appreciate their efforts, but we need to understand the severity and impact this is having on our operation.

We cannot continue operating this way. We have employees ready to work, drivers actively completing replenishments, and orders that have been created in the system, yet we are unable to maintain a consistent picking flow. This directly impacts productivity, employee utilization, and our ability to meet our daily goals.

At this point, we need this issue treated as a high-priority operational concern. We need to identify why orders are not flowing into RTP and get the process back to normal as soon as possible.

I will continue following up with the Automation Team, but I wanted to make sure management is aware of the seriousness of this situation and the impact it is having on our operation.

closed.Subject: At PPS 9 Inbound
closed.subject: At PPS 9 Inbound
closed.Description:
PPS 9 Inbound, the GreyOrange system displays the error No PPS point available when the customer attempts to induct a tote.
The issue occurs in two situations:
During tote induction: The customer scans the tote barcode multiple times, but the system does not assign an available PPS point.
After a long period of inactivity: The same error appears even though the user has not logged out of the system.
This suggests a possible issue with PPS point availability, the application session, or communication between the station and the backend. The exact root cause needs to be confirmed through system checks.

closed.Subject: gStore 2nd Line - ISR Pool Not Updating in a Timely Manner After Refill Activities - INC7162570
closed.subject: gStore 2nd Line - ISR Pool Not Updating in a Timely Manner After Refill Activities - INC7162570
closed.Description:
Hi Team, 

Store ID: CH0927. 

The store reported the following: 

Hi,

We conducted several tests yesterday in CH0927 to investigate the behavior of item localization and ISR Pool updates following refill activities.
Similar behavior has been reported by multiple stores in Switzerland (CH), the Netherlands (NL), and Austria (AT).

Test Scenario
We processed multiple replenishment lists using both options:

"No, I'll put them myself"
"Yes, put using gStore"

The results were identical in both cases, although the Store Manager informed us that selecting "Yes, put using gStore" should normally result in a faster update.

Localization Results
After completing the lists, all items were physically moved to the sales floor.

When performing a HAS on the items, the localization behaved as expected:
Within approximately 45 minutes, the articles were correctly localized in the appropriate sales floor zone.
This was observed consistently regardless of which completion option was selected.

ISR Pool Behavior
The behavior of the ISR Pool differs significantly and does not appear to update in a timely manner.

Observed behavior:
Once the list is completed and the items are moved to the sales floor, the articles disappear from the ISR Pool for approximately 15-20 minutes.
They then reappear in the ISR Pool roughly 20 minutes later.
The articles remain visible in the ISR Pool for at least 1 hour and 30 minutes, despite already being physically present on the sales floor and correctly localized via HAS.
Only after this period does the ISR Pool finally update and reflect the correct situation.

Business Impact
As a result, stores are unable to reliably perform refill activities every hour, as the ISR Pool does not accurately reflect the actual stock situation on the sales floor and appears to be updated with a significant delay.

This creates uncertainty for store teams and may lead to unnecessary refill tasks, reduced operational efficiency, and lower confidence in the ISR Pool as ...

closed.Subject: gStore 2nd Line -Fulfillment  issue -INC7181319
closed.subject: gStore 2nd Line -Fulfillment  issue -INC7181319
closed.Description:
Hi Team,

Missing CREATED Fulfillment Events Causing False Alerts

Our investigation identified a data quality issue in the GreyOrange fulfillment event generation process. For certain fulfillments (for example, 70724249603 and 70724591843), the expected CREATED event is missing from the fulfillmentEvents.event history.

This creates an operational edge case where a fulfillment is created, but the first recorded event is generated only after a significant delay (more than one hour later), such as PRODUCTS_PICKED, READY_FOR_PICKUP, DELIVERED, or another downstream status.

During this period, monitoring has no event indicating that the fulfillment has reached the system, which results in false alerts and incident creation by the Production Assurance Unit.

While it may be suggested that the creation state can be derived from fulfillmentProgress.process_status = CREATED, this is not a reliable workaround. The fulfillmentProgress.process_status field and related fulfillment attributes are updated as the order progresses and do not retain historical status values. Therefore, the original CREATED status may no longer be available when the alert condition is evaluated.

Our analysis confirms that this is not a data ingestion or latency issue. The root cause appears to be the missing CREATED fulfillment event in the event history, which impacts monitoring accuracy and leads to false incident generation.

Can you please check on this 

Thanks,
 Ramamohan N

customer* regarding this incident.

Could you please assist the store in troubleshooting and resolving this issue?

closed.Subject: INC0949813 14545  SIM: The inventory quantity is incorrect in SIM for UPC#198605175480
closed.subject: INC0949813 14545  SIM: The inventory quantity is incorrect in SIM for UPC#198605175480
closed.Description:
Hi G store team,
For item #198605175480 and Store#14545  , we can see that from 29-Sep to 13-Oct, the store had an available inventory of 3 units.
On 14-Oct, the store performed a cycle count. However, we observed that a false adjustment of +1 unit was posted, which resulted in an inventory variance.
As per the store's confirmation, the physical inventory was 3 units. Prior to the cycle count, the system inventory was also 3 units. However, after the adjustment was posted, the inventory in SIM increased to 4 units, even though the physical inventory remained at 3 units.
Could you investigate and let us know why the adjustment was posted after the cycle count, even though both the physical inventory and system inventory were matching at 3 units before the count was performed?
Thanks,
Denzel

closed.Subject: CZ0042 / Hypercare / Zone mIsmatch
closed.subject: CZ0042 / Hypercare / Zone mIsmatch
closed.Description:
Hi Team,

It has been reported that during remote testing of store CZ0042, which started on 16 Oct, multiple EPCs were found to have inconsistent location reporting between Keonn Cloud and GStore across zones CP2, SR3, and Z5-Z10.

The issue was initially reported directly to Keonn via email. Keonn's initial assessment was that the discrepancies could be related to a mismatch between the GStore and Keonn zone maps. However, after reviewing the mappings from reader stream, they could not identify any obvious mapping errors that would explain the behaviour.

Seems Keonn has subsequently contacted Yagna for further investigation, but after several days without any feedback or progress, the issue has been reported to Hypercare support, as testing has already been ongoing since 16 Oct.

Multiple EPCs are being reported in different locations in Keonn Cloud and GStore, indicating a potential location accuracy issue. A possible cause could be reader placement, configuration, mapping, or another underlying integration issue, but this has not yet been confirmed.

Examples and screenshots are attached. Additional EPC examples are available for all affected zones if required.

Request:
Please investigate the discrepancies between Keonn Cloud and GStore, verify zone mappings and reader placement/configuration, identify the root cause, and provide recommendations for resolution and next steps.

Regards,
Pradeep

closed.Description:
We have identified recurring elevated response times for pause and resume operations on Zone-301 at site BRSP04.

- August 19, 23:36:47 — pause: 2.63 s
- August 22, 13:03:25 — resume: 3.4 s
- September 10, 08:49:49 — pause: 2.58 s
- September 17, 16:59:35 — pause: 4 s
Endpoints observed:
/sites/BR/warehouses/BRSP04/safety/zones/Zone-301/pause
/sites/BR/warehouses/BRSP04/safety/zones/Zone-301/resume
Based on the warehouse layout, Zone-301 is not the largest zone in the site; for example, Zone-401 appears to cover a larger operational area. However, we repeatedly observe higher response times when pause or resume actions are executed for Zone-301.
Could you please investigate whether there are factors beyond the physical size of the zone that could affect the processing time for Zone-301? In particular, we would like to understand whether its configuration, associated resources, active rules, operational status, or internal processing queues could be contributing to this behavior.
Please also let us know if you identify any relevant anomalies in the logs around the timestamps listed above.

Which HTTP requests are failing and where these requests are originating from.

The reasons for the HTTP request failures.

Why the API backups are not completing successfully.

Whether these failures are directly contributing to the plan failures.

Please share the detailed findings and root cause to help us confirm the correlation between these issues and the plan failures.

closed.Description:
Hi Team,
Please create a service ticket for the following issue at EL ATL.
Issue: HTMs are going into error on the Aisle 10 lower-side path with a
path block issue, even though Tower shows the barcodes on that path as
unblocked.
Location: Aisle 10, lower-side path
Time (approx.): Starting 10/26/26, 6:45 PM EST
Bots affected: HTM 114, HTM 135, HTM 137
Observations:
* All three bots went into error on the same path.
* Tower shows the barcodes on this path as unblocked.
Action taken:
* The Aisle 10 lower path was blocked manually in Tower.
* Since then, the bots are routing around through the other path and
working normally.
Request: Please check why the bots are getting a path block on this path
when Tower shows the barcodes as unblocked. The lower path will stay
blocked until this is resolved.
Screenshots are attached for reference.
Thanks,
Karthik

closed.subject: Urgent: Cycle Count Issue at Store US0068 – Immediate Assistance Required
closed.Description:
Hi Team,

Store US0068 is unable to complete cycle counts. Initially, some products are counted successfully, but the counting process then stops and no additional items are counted. Although the RFID gun displays a blinking green light indicating scans are being detected, the count does not increase.

This is a new store, and we have already performed troubleshooting, including testing with multiple RFID guns. However, the issue persists across all devices.

As a result, a significant portion of the store's inventory has not yet been counted, and the store requires an urgent resolution. Please find the attached recording for reference in the ticket. The store is also available for a live troubleshooting session. Could you please schedule a call and investigate this issue as a priority?

Please note that this same store previously experienced issues with unrecognized ASNs, so we would appreciate this being treated with high priority. We are looking for both a resolution and an RCA as soon as possible to minimize the operational impact.

Thank you for your urgent attention to this matter.

Regards,
Chetan Naik

closed.subject: Ranger Re-Entering Induct Queue with No Scan Attempt Logged |Lacoste|RMS
closed.Description:
Hi Team,

*Reported Issue:  *Attached is a video and an excel file with Data with the
test cases highlighted in yellow. This video shows what is happening, when
two small tickets are inducted for the same ranger then there is a delay,
then the ranger circles back into the induct queue. And there is no record
of the scan attempt.

the video was recorded at 1352 EST on June 24th 2026
 on ranger 7018


when one of these Dillard's cases with two labels are inducted 1 at a time
it sorts it just fine fyi, it is just when there is one of these Dillard's
with two labels, with any other small ticket sort

I think the issue stems from the 1-4 sorting rules originally set up as
these cases weren't part of the implementation data we had at that time.

the cases causing the issues do fall under Rule 2 AND Rule 3



Rule1: Accept any code beginning with 1Z, max 256 chars
Rule2: Accept any 34-character code beginning with 1 or 96
Rule3: Accept any 20-digit numeric code beginning with 00008
Rule4: Accept any 10-digit numeric code

OLD Cases: 258941


Thanks,
Raushan Kumar

closed.subject: ARITZIA NON-PROD | GM 7.9 | Duplicate TaskDetailComplete Message Received for Short-Picked Order
closed.Description:
*   Title: Aritzia Defect 236:  ARITZIA NON-PROD | GM 7.9 | Duplicate TaskDetailComplete Message Received for Short-Picked Order
  *   Severity: M

  *   Symptom:
During Blue Sky short-pick scenario, user marked 1 item as missing from the order, resulting in a short-picked scenario. The missing item was correctly assigned the cancel code C-GO-INV. However, Robotics Hub received the TaskDetailComplete message for the same TaskDetailID twice.
The first TaskDetailComplete message was processed successfully. When the duplicate message was received, Robotics Hub attempted to process it again and returned a WMS Acknowledgement = Failed with the error message "No rows affected".
Order is cancelled successfully in BY and a record generated and order goes to PNDCONV-CHASE as expected.

  *   Steps to Reproduce:
1. Release order to GO

  1.  Mark 1 item as missing so order goes into 'Complete-Short Pick' in GO


  *   Expected:
When an item is short-picked and cancelled with C-GO-INV, Robotics Hub should receive one TaskDetailComplete message for the affected TaskDetailID. The message should be processed successfully and acknowledged once.

  *   Actual:
Robotics Hub received two TaskDetailComplete messages for task ID 10989323 TaskDetailID W000001KZNJY.

  *   First TaskDetailComplete message processed successfully.
  *   Duplicate TaskDetailComplete message was received afterward.
  *   The duplicate message resulted in:
     *   WMS Acknowledgement: Failed
     *   Error Message: "No rows affected"

Thank you,

We have identified several similar cases of this type.

closed.Subject: Production Configuration Update and Server Restart – 1-Hour Downtime
closed.subject: Production Configuration Update and Server Restart – 1-Hour Downtime
closed.Description:
We would like to request a downtime window of one hour to implement configuration changes and restart the production server.

Issue:
When the system receives a PUT request for a masterbox type, it throws an error if an item with a different masterbox type but the same box capacity already exists in the system.

Action Plan:
We have added the necessary configurations and tested them in the staging environment. To implement the fix in production, we need to update the configurations and restart the server.

Expected Outcome:
Once the configuration changes and server restart are completed, the system should successfully accept the same item with different masterbox types, provided they have the same box capacity.

closed.Description:
Hi Team,

We are opening this ticket to continue the investigation previously reported in case 00285524, which has been closed.

The original case reported recurring latency in pause operations, particularly for Zone-11 at BRSP15. In your latest responses, you requested more recent instances with explicit timestamps and timezone, as your log retention period is limited to 30 days.

We now have the following recent instances from BRSP15. These instances correspond to resume operations, and we would like you to investigate whether they are related to the behavior reported in the original case.

All timestamps below are in UTC.

The corresponding GreyOrange endpoint URLs are:

https://brffsp15-prod.greymatter.greyorange.com/api-gateway/maop-service/zone/Zone-13/resume

https://brffsp15-prod.greymatter.greyorange.com/api-gateway/maop-service/zone/Zone-14/resume

https://brffsp15-prod.greymatter.greyorange.com/api-gateway/maop-service/zone/Zone-11/resume

We are attaching a JSON file for each instance containing the case ID, UTC timestamp, trace ID, span ID, parent ID, request path, corresponding GreyOrange URL, and measured duration.

Could you please review your logs around these timestamps and help us identify what contributed to these response times? Please also confirm the expected response time for these operations and whether zone configuration, associated resources, active rules, operational status, or internal queues could affect their duration.

Thanks.

closed.Description:
@GreyOrange Service <service@greyorange.com>, please create a ticket for
this request and assign it to TAC for investigation.

David has requested clarification on the system’s picking logic,
specifically how SKUs and slots are selected for picking. The key questions
are:

   -

   *Slot Selection Logic:* How does the system determine which slot to
   select for a picking task?
   -

   *Same SKU Across Multiple Stations:* If the same SKU is required at
   multiple stations and a single slot has sufficient inventory, does the
   system assign the same slot to all stations or select different slots?
   -

   *Rack/Slot Reassignment:* If the same rack/slot is required at multiple
   stations and its delivery to one station is delayed, does the system
   reassign another rack/slot for the same SKU after a defined cutoff time? If
   so, is this timeout configurable?

*Observed Site Impact:* Stations are experiencing starvation due to the
unavailability of MSUs, while the PPS screens display "*Waiting for MSU"*.

closed.Subject: H80 – Race condition on WebSocket disconnect: bot closes connection before Safety Controller ACKs "unsubscribe"
closed.subject: H80 – Race condition on WebSocket disconnect: bot closes connection before Safety Controller ACKs "unsubscribe"
closed.Description:
We've identified a race condition in the H80's connection lifecycle with the Safety Controller (SC).

Context: Unlike previous models, the H80 does not keep a persistent WebSocket connection to the SC. It connects only when entering the station's buffer zone and disconnects when leaving it.

Issue: Before leaving the buffer zone, the bot sends an "unsubscribe" event to the SC and then immediately closes the WebSocket connection, without waiting for the SC's ACK. In some cases, the SC processes the "unsubscribe" and attempts to write the ACK response back on a connection the bot has already closed, resulting in an error on the SC side.

Requested fix: The bot should wait to receive the SC's ACK for the "unsubscribe" event before closing the WebSocket connection, instead of closing it immediately after sending "unsubscribe".

Impact: Intermittent errors on the Safety Controller caused by writes to closed connections, occurring on every buffer-zone exit cycle for H80 units.

closed.Description:
HI Team,

We are seeing an ongoing data quality issue in vw_raw_inventory_hourly affecting a large number of US stores.

The inventory snapshots are expected to be delivered approximately once per hour. 
However, for many US stores we are receiving multiple snapshots within the same hour while other hours are completely missing.

This issue was previously reported and we understood that it should have been fixed from 2026-08-26, but our analysis shows that the problem continued after this date and is still visible in the data.

For example, for US0370 on 2026-09-08 we received 23 snapshot timestamps, but these only cover 18 distinct hours. Several hours contain two snapshots while other hours have no snapshot at all.

Examples of duplicate snapshots within the same hour:
04:00:17
04:32:14

08:03:52
08:32:26

11:04:22
11:33:51

16:02:39
16:33:22

18:01:59
18:32:13

At country level, our check for 2026-09-08 shows:
Country: US
Stores with data: 315
Stores with fewer than 20 distinct hourly snapshots: 128
Affected stores: 40.6%
Worst observed example: 18 distinct hourly snapshots

And PL0041 is also missing snapshots regularly, see attachments


We have also reviewed the trend from 2026-08-26 onward, and the irregular/missing hourly snapshots continue beyond the previously communicated fix date, including into September.

Expected:
Each store should receive approximately one inventory snapshot per hour, resulting in close to 24 distinct hourly snapshots per complete day.

Actual:
Snapshots are arriving irregularly. Multiple snapshots can arrive within the same hour while other hours are skipped, resulting in significantly fewer distinct hourly snapshots.

Impact:
This creates gaps in our inventory_hourly history and affects downstream reporting and analysis that relies on consistent hourly inventory snapshots.

Could you please investigate:

Why snapshots are still being generated at irregular intervals after the communicated fix on 2026-08-26?

closed.Subject: Race condition between zone pause and resume requests leaves waypoints blocked
closed.subject: Race condition between zone pause and resume requests leaves waypoints blocked
closed.Description:
We identified a race condition when the pause and resume operations for the same zone are submitted within a short time interval.
Although the reproduction example below uses BRFFSP15 Staging, the issue is not limited to staging. We have observed the same behavior across the other sites as well.
When a resume request is sent while the preceding pause request is still being processed, both API requests return successful responses. However, the resulting state is inconsistent:
- The zone is reported by the API as resumed/unblocked.
- The waypoints associated with the zone remain blocked.
- Robots cannot use those waypoints, disrupting robotics operations.
Sending another resume request does not resolve the inconsistency because the zone state is already recorded as resumed. To recover, we must send another pause, wait for it to complete, and then send resume again.
Steps to reproduce
1. Send the following request:
POST https://brffsp15-stg.greymatter.greyorange.com/api-gateway/maop-service/zone/Zone-5/pause
Authorization: <token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "reason": "default_reason"
}
2. Without waiting for the response or completion of the pause operation, immediately send:
POST https://brffsp15-stg.greymatter.greyorange.com/api-gateway/maop-service/zone/Zone-5/resume
Authorization: <token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "reasons": [
    "default_reason"
  ]
}
3. Confirm that both requests return successful HTTP responses.
4. Check the zone status and the status of its associated waypoints.
For other sites, the same test can be performed by replacing the base URL with the corresponding site URL.
Actual result
The API reports the zone as resumed/unblocked, but the associated waypoints remain blocked. A subsequent resume request also returns successfully but does not unblock the waypoints.
Expected result
Concurrent or closely timed pause and resume requests for the same zone should be processed in the order in which they were received. The final state of...

Old case # 00251560

Alpha sizes in all Canadian stores are set to French. closed.Subject: Hypercare - INC7111610 replenishment issue
closed.subject: Hypercare - INC7111610 replenishment issue
closed.Description:
The store requested changing the Visual Room zone status from Stockroom to Sales Floor, as they observed replenishment stock being generated for that location and believed the current zoning was causing inaccurate replenishment.​‌

The store confirmed that the Visual Room remains a Stockroom area but stated that its current setup is generating additional replenishment, and therefore requested it be marked as Sales Floor.​‌


While we checked with Store design team on the change they clarified that a Visual Room cannot be configured as a Sales Floor area. By design, any room classified as a Visual Room must remain a Visual Room; Sales Floor areas must be configured as numbered sales zones. Therefore, the requested zoning change is not possible. The team advised that the replenishment behavior should be investigated separately, as it is not related to the Visual Room zoning configuration.​‌

Hence, we require your support to validate the replenishment issue observed in this store​‌

Meanwhile we are also trying to collect some sample articles for investigation

closed.Description:

We have been reported with an issue that they have found some cases in the table vw_raw_inventory_hourly, where it seems that we are losing data. 

The number of epc in the store PL0155 is fluctuating between around 15.000 and 40.000, a few days have almost half epc that other days ("2026-09-02","2026-09-03",,"2026-09-06","2026-09-07") as can be seen in the next query:

    select
        date(timestamp) date_rk,
        store_id,
        count(distinct epc_id) as total_pcs,
    from `gstore-production.production_hmgroup_analytics_EU_shared.vw_raw_inventory_hourly`
    where TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(timestamp, DAY) >= TIMESTAMP("2026-09-01")
    and store_id = 'PL0155'

If they check one of these days, they see that for each hour they have more o less the same number of epcs.

Another case is with the store  'NL0153', where we go from having around 78.633 pcs one day to 50.687 pcs the next day and the following days.

Please check this issue and assist further on this.

Thanks.

closed.Subject: Item Unscannable Feature Gap
closed.subject: Item Unscannable Feature Gap
closed.Description:
Hi GO Team,

WHAT:
During the initial End-to-End testing for Grey Orange Put away and Picking last year, we came across a gap related to the feature 'Item Unscannable'. Items flagged "Item Unscannable" do not generate a transaction message from GO to BY, resulting in the movement not being reflected in Blue Yonder.

Current process for items that are unscannable are flagged through the use of Exit STN or through the Missing exception.
However, this does not prevent a user from using this function as it is available to be selected on the AIO.

Below are examples of when Item Unscannable was used in production which resulted in failed messages and misaligned inventory:

[cid:dbb4328b-6b4e-48c3-ba40-33a4122c5808]

During the testing phase, GO advised that the 'Item Unscannable' feature could not be removed. Is this still the current case?
Given that the feature is unmapped, is there a way to disable/remove the feature or restrict the user to select this exception type?

Any other recommendations to prevent the user from triggering Item Unscannable would also be appreciated.

Thank you,


Jules Bernal

closed.Subject: Aritzia DC01P | Inventory Location Data
closed.subject: Aritzia DC01P | Inventory Location Data
closed.Description:
Hi Grey Orange,

We would like GreyOrange to review the availability of inventory location data in the GO platform and advise on how it can be made available for operations to analyze

We are looking for visibility to the following data elements:

  *
Grid Barcode ID
  *
MSU ID
  *
MSU Location
  *
SKU

Why are we looking for it?
We believe access to inventory location data could help us find ways to improve efficiency within the GO system
Our primary area of interest is increasing Picks Per Face by understanding where inventory is physically located within the grid and evaluating opportunities to align demand accordingly. The ability to identify inventory that is stored in close proximity may allow us to reduce the number of faces required to complete an order while improving pick density.
In addition, understanding the physical relationship between inventory locations would support future cartonization enhancements. By understanding where inventory resides within the grid, we can begin assessing opportunities to combine units and demand nodes in a way that reduces travel and improves overall system efficiency.

Potential benefits include:

  *
Increased Picks Per Face
  *
Reduced bot travel
  *
Improved cartonization outcomes
  *
Improved robot cycle times
  *
Increased throughput
  *
Travel sequence optimization opportunities
  *
Improved inventory placement and replenishment strategies

How would we use the data?
Initially, the data would be used by Distribution to optimize ecommerce and retail cartonization.

What are we asking GreyOrange?

  1.
Is this data currently available within the GO platform?
  2.
Is there an existing extract, report, API, Grafana view, or other mechanism that already provides this information?

closed.Description:
Hi team,

We are currently experiencing a communication issue with robot 8333. The robot is powered on; however, it does not appear connected in RDS, and we are also unable to access it through RoboShop.

We have already performed the following checks:

First, we inspected the antennas, considering a possible communication failure. The corresponding tests were performed, but the issue persisted.
We then installed a new MOXA device to rule out a hardware failure on the communication device.
Even with the new MOXA, we were still unable to establish communication with the robot, including when attempting a direct connection via LAN cable.

Based on these tests, we have currently ruled out an issue directly related to the antennas or the MOXA device.

At this time, we have no access to the robot at all, which also means we are unable to download the logs required for further troubleshooting.

Could you please help us investigate what might be causing the complete loss of communication with the robot and advise us on any additional checks or tests we can perform to identify the root cause and restore access?

closed.Subject: Missing Movement Record and User ID in Task 14039682
closed.subject: Missing Movement Record and User ID in Task 14039682
closed.Description:
Hi GO Support,

We have identified an issue involving a missing movement record from GO and a COMPLETED message that failed to process due to a missing user ID.

Task ID: 14039682
Task Type: GO_STO

Summary
The GO_PUT task was completed; however, RH did not receive the full set of expected movement records. Additionally, the COMPLETED message sent to RH could not be processed because the user ID was missing from the payload.

Impact
There is currently no automated detection or alerting for this issue. The team only becomes aware of the problem after it is reported by a user, at which point manual intervention in BY is required to correct the affected task.

Request
Please investigate the following:

  *
Why the GO_STGFULL movement record was not sent by GO.
  *
Why the resent GO_STGCUB message contained the user ID `tac`.
  *
Why the COMPLETED payload was sent without a user ID.

Issue 1: Missing GO_STGFULL Movement Record
Actual:
The user dropped the item into the cubby. When the MSU arrived, the user selected Bring Bigger for the front location and Warehouse Full for the back location. The task status is now Completed; however, RH only received the GO_STGCUB movement record and did not receive the GO_STGFULL movement record.

Expected:
RH should receive both movement records, GO_STGCUB and GO_STGFULL, with the correct user ID and complete transaction details.

Issue 2: GO_STGCUB Resent with User ID `tac`
Actual:
After identifying the missing user ID, GO resent the GO_STGCUB message; however, the resent message contained the user ID `tac`.

Expected:
The movement message should contain the correct user ID associated with the original user action.

Issue 3: Missing User ID in COMPLETED Payload
Actual:
RH received the COMPLETED message, but processing failed because the user ID field was missing from the payload.

Expected:
The COMPLETED message should include all required fields, including the user ID, to ensure successful processing by RH.

closed.Subject: More than 30 Robots Offline
closed.subject: More than 30 Robots Offline
closed.Description:
Hello! Following up on the previous ticket 00266546 (closed without a conclusive resolution) regarding the event in which 30 robots went offline simultaneously at the SP15 warehouse.

In the last response, the GreyOrange team informed us that the EMQX logs for the requested timeframe could not be retrieved due to Logstash entering an infinite retry loop while attempting to push an oversized payload, which caused it to stop accepting new incoming data. It was also mentioned that the issue had been escalated with the highest priority to the relevant internal team, with the goal of implementing alerts to detect similar log-saving failures early.

Since the ticket was closed without further clarification, we are formally requesting continued follow-up, with objective answers to the points below:

1. What is the current status of the escalation mentioned, and which internal GreyOrange team is responsible for it?
2. Has the root cause of the oversized payload that triggered the Logstash retry loop been identified? What caused this payload to fall outside normal parameters?
3. What concrete changes have already been implemented (or are in progress) in the logging infrastructure (Logstash/EMQX) to prevent an ingestion failure from blocking log recording again?
4. Have the early-detection alerts mentioned already been implemented? If so, since when are they active, and which components do they cover (Logstash, EMQX, GCP push pipeline)?
5. Is there an estimated timeline (ETA) for completing these corrective actions, if still in progress?

We would like to emphasize that the absence of the logs from the original event prevents a complete analysis of the root cause behind the simultaneous shutdown of the 30 robots, which is critical to preventing recurrence. We request a detailed, written response before this ticket is closed.

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards!

closed.Subject: Issues with the ROBOSHOP version and time Config.
closed.subject: Issues with the ROBOSHOP version and time Config.
closed.Description:
Dear Team,

I am writing to report a configuration issue on RoboShop that is impacting
both local maintenance operations and remote troubleshooting.

We are currently unable to change the device time on the RoboShop, and it
is not displaying our local time. Instead, the timestamps are skewed—for
example, showing an incorrect time zone offset (-1100) relative to our
local logs. This discrepancy is directly causing issues when trying to
download and analyze logs both on-site and for the remote teams, as it
makes accurate timestamp matching impossible.

Additionally, we require a stable RoboShop version for the ops laptop. The
current version we are using (2.5.16.0) is not stable and crashes
frequently, particularly when editing maps or clearing errors. We need
either a stable lower version or the latest version file to install on the
Linux laptop. Please share the installation file.

Best regards,

Shabariraj Siddeswaran
